message.content:
Here’s a quick mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films that cover a range of sub‑genres—so you’ll have something whether you’re into psychological dread, supernatural chills, or outright gore:

| # | Title | Year | Sub‑genre | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|-----------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **Psycho** | 1960 | Psychological / Thriller | Hitchcock’s masterclass in suspense; the shower scene is legendary. |
| 2 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Psychological / Supernatural | Kubrick’s eerie adaptation of Stephen King’s novel; haunting visuals & atmosphere. |
| 3 | **Halloween** | 1978 | Slasher | The original “killer mask” film that defined the slasher formula. |
| 4 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | Supernatural | One of the most unsettling exorcism stories ever filmed. |
| 5 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Psychological / Supernatural | Modern horror that blends family drama with creeping dread. |
| 6 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Social Commentary / Horror | A smart, satirical take on racism that still delivers genuine scares. |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Survival / Sci‑Fi | Silence is survival; the tension is palpable. |
| 8 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Folk Horror | Daylight horror that turns the sunny Swedish setting into a nightmare. |
| 9 | **It Follows** | 2014 | Urban Legend / Psychological | A fresh take on the “invisible stalker” trope. |
|10 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological / Supernatural | A metaphorical look at grief that becomes genuinely terrifying. |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Supernatural / Mystery | The viral video curse is creepy and effective. |
|12 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Found Footage | Low‑budget found‑footage style that still manages to scare. |
|13 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | Paranormal / Supernatural | A well‑crafted haunted house story with strong characters. |
|14 | **Saw** | 2004 | Psychological / Thriller | The first of a long-running series that focuses on moral dilemmas. |
|15 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Meta‑Horror | A clever twist on the cabin‑in‑the‑woods trope. |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like recommendations tailored to a specific era, sub‑genre, or even a particular mood (e.g., “I want something more atmospheric than gory”). Happy watching!
